name: speech_text
description: Read a project's speech as numbered transcript lines, with pauses, to edit as text. Writes speech-text.md in the project folder and returns the same text. Edit it, then run speech_edit.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {path, text, track, stamp, sources, lines, duration, warnings}

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: track
params.description: Track id of the speech track. Leave out to use the track with the most transcribed speech.

params.name: unused
params.description: lines lists every source line not fully in the cut, so you can bring takes back; none leaves it out.
